question: Do the public PHercParis4 fibers run within the papyrus sheet seen in CT, i.e. is the fiber tangent closer to perpendicular to the local CT sheet normal than a random direction is?

inputs.support_evidence: artifacts/2026-10-04-paris4-fiber-ct-support-run/result.json (SUPPORTED; evidence for, not a declaration of, the binding)
inputs.byte_rule: every fiber re-downloaded and hash-matched; any failure is RUN FAILED

volume.read: whole uncompressed level-1 chunks covering each cube; absent chunk = fill value 0

sampling.point_rule: line indices round(linspace(h, n-1-h, 8)), duplicates dropped, h = tangent_half_window

structure_tensor.normal: eigenvector of the largest eigenvalue of the Gaussian-window-weighted gradient outer-product tensor at the cube centre, expressed in (x, y, z)
structure_tensor.skip_rule: points whose cube leaves the volume, is more than max_zero_fraction zero, or has coherence (l1-l2)/(l1+l2) below min_coherence are skipped and counted

groups.F: fiber points with their own tangents
groups.R: the same normals against one uniform random unit direction each (null reference: |r.n| ~ U(0,1))
groups.X: wrong-frame control: points and tangents with x and y swapped
groups.XR: random directions against the X normals

decision.statistic: D = mean |r.n| - mean |t.n|, paired at the same points
decision.rule: CONTROL FAILURE if the swapped-frame D CI lower bound > min_D. Otherwise SUPPORTED iff the D CI lower bound > min_D; else NOT SUPPORTED.

interpretation_limits: SUPPORTED means fiber tangents tend to lie in the local CT sheet plane; it does not identify which sheet, nor verify horizontal/vertical fiber identity.
The structure tensor sees dominant layering; in compressed or damaged regions the normal may follow other structure.
The volume binding is evidence-based, not declared by the dataset.
